text:
Maya Scott: quick sync — Luma IT private/VPC onboarding: we're blocked on a couple infra pieces (network peering + KMS grants + audit log target). want to align owners and schedule a dry-run before their trial window ends.
Javier Ortiz: can you list specific blockers? short bullets are fine.
Maya Scott: sure —
• Network: need VPC peering + route tables updated, avoid CIDR overlap, confirm S3/VPC endpoints for model artifacts
• IAM: customer needs us to assume a cross-account role; they want explicit role ARN and trust policy
• KMS: Luma requires a customer-managed CMK with grant to Redwood role and monthly rotation
• Audit logs: send control-plane logs to their Splunk; need destination IP/port + firewall rule
Anya Patel: for network — peering + routes is straightforward if CIDRs don't overlap. If they do we'll suggest a proxy NAT path. Also need their allowed egress for model pulls (S3 endpoints) and STS endpoints.
Anya Patel: for KMS, we need their key policy to include:
```
"Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDCUSTOMER:role/redwood-inference-deploy"},
"Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "REDCUSTOMER"}}
```
+ a Grant so our serving instances can decrypt.
Luma IT: thanks — we opened an internal ticket (INC-8472). CIDR is 10.2.0.0/16 (customer). We can carve a /20 if needed. KMS key is managed, can add grant, rotation enforced monthly. For Splunk we have a forwarder at 54.23.12.8:514 (tcp).
Maya Scott: perfect, that's actionable. @Anya can you confirm whether our rollout needs any special bastion access or extra firewall ports for the runbook?
Anya Patel: bastion only for debug; normal traffic from the serving nodes needs outbound 443 to S3, 443 to sts.amazonaws.com, and tcp/514 to the Splunk endpoint (if they choose syslog). We'll put the bastion step as optional in the runbook.
Javier Ortiz: I'll own the customer handoff and acceptance test. Proposed dry-run: Fri 13:00 PT. Goal: stand up private control-plane, validate KMS decrypt, push a small model pull, and verify events reach Splunk.
Luma IT: Fri 13:00 PT works. Also note: renewal manager flagged a risk — if go-live slips past next-quarter billing cycle, procurement may delay. They asked for a short sign-off checklist after dry-run.
Maya Scott: noted — we'll produce a 1-page sign-off: env checks, KMS decrypt test, ingest perf baseline, audit logs verified. Javier, can you assemble that and include a pass/fail column?
Javier Ortiz: yep. I'll draft and share by Thu EOD. Quick perf ask: Luma wants baseline at ~1k reqs/min for inference p50 < 200ms. Can infra provide a perf harness?
Anya Patel: we have a lightweight harness. Need their sample prompt set (~50) and concurrency profile. We can run in canary pool to avoid noisy neighbors.
deploy-bot: Deployment job #422 queued for 1749954321-kms-test (status: pending).
Luma IT: one more Q — key rotation: when you rotate, will existing cached model keys break sessions? they want warm handover.
Anya Patel: rotation uses a new key version with automatic re-encrypt; we'll ensure KV cache invalidation plan in runbook and support a short-maint window. We'll document steps.
Maya Scott: action items summary:
- Javier: draft sign-off checklist + own dry-run (due Thu EOD)
- Anya: prepare runbook sections for network, KMS policy snippet, Splunk forwarding (due Thu EOD)
- Luma IT: confirm final CIDR carve and provide sample prompts + Splunk endpoint creds (ASAP)
Next sync: Fri 13:00 PT for dry-run. If anything blocks earlier, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
